_about: Chess bot portraits (docs/CHESS-LOOK-PLAN.md stage 5): the Very Easy chick, the Easy robot and the Medium wizard, cut out of white. Paint: python scripts/game_art.py docs/chess-art/bots.json paint ~/dragon-art-inbox/chess-bots

styles.a: Hand-painted fantasy storybook character portrait for a children's game, rich glowing colours, soft painterly light, bold clean readable shape, friendly and full of personality, for children aged 8 to 11, no writing, no letters, no numbers.

pictures.name: bot/very-easy
pictures.prompt: A cute fluffy little yellow baby chick that has just hatched, a broken half eggshell sitting on its head like a hat, big shiny happy eyes, tiny orange beak open in a giggle, hugging a small wooden chess pawn a bit wobbly, sweet and silly. Upper body, facing the viewer, the whole character and the chess piece visible and centred with space all around, on a plain pure white background, clean empty white all around.

pictures.name: bot/easy
pictures.prompt: A cheerful friendly little round robot made of shiny teal and silver metal, a glowing screen face with two big round blue eyes and a smile, a springy antenna with a glowing ball on top, holding up a white chess knight piece proudly. Upper body, facing the viewer, the whole character and the chess piece visible and centred with space all around, on a plain pure white background, clean empty white all around.

pictures.name: bot/medium
pictures.prompt: A wise kind old wizard with a long fluffy white beard, twinkling eyes and rosy cheeks, a tall pointed deep purple hat and robe covered in little gold stars and moons, holding up a glowing magical chess queen piece in one hand, a knowing smile. Upper body, facing the viewer, the whole character and the chess piece visible and centred with space all around, on a plain pure white background, clean empty white all around.
